summary: A Yes vote modifies the City of Orange's transient occupancy (hotel guest) tax.

tax.text: The Yes campaign supports increasing taxes on guests at larger hotels to fund police, fire, streets, parks, and other city services.
tax.quote: Every day, visitors staying in Orange hotels rely on our police officers, firefighters, streets, parks, and other public services. Measure J simply asks visitors to contribute more toward the community they enjoy.

tax.text: A No vote rejects increasing Orange’s hotel occupancy tax from 10% to 14% for hotels with 11 or more rooms and extending the tax to online and other travel companies.
tax.quote: A “No” vote on Measure J does not authorize those changes to the City’s Transient Occupancy Tax.
